description: This file defines a local data source class for managing shared preferences related to onboarding status in a mobile expense tracker app.

classes.name: LocalPrefsDataSource
classes.description: Provides methods to get and set onboarding status using shared preferences.

methods.name: getHasOnboarded
methods.description: Retrieves the onboarding status from shared preferences, returns false if not set.

methods.name: setHasOnboarded
methods.description: Sets the onboarding status in shared preferences.
